# rtbgen

> Deterministic OpenRTB 2.5/2.6 bid request generator for Rust tests, fuzzing and load runs.
> Generates wire JSON, not types, so it works with every OpenRTB crate.

## When to use

- Writing a test that needs an OpenRTB 2.5 or 2.6 bid request (any shape).
- Generating request corpora for load tests (`oha`, `drill`).
- Reproducing a bug: a seed plus a profile is the whole fixture.
- Checking that a parser treats optional objects as optional (`Sparse`).

## When not to use

- You need a *typed* OpenRTB model to read requests: use `iab-specs-openrtb` or `openrtb`.
- You need to validate a document against the spec: use `rtblint`.
- You need VAST: use `vast4-rs` or `vastlint`.

## Quick start

```rust
use rtbgen::{Currency, Deals, Floor, ImpressionCount, Profile, Request, Seed};

let req = Request::builder(Profile::AppRewarded)
    .seed(Seed::new(42))
    .impressions(ImpressionCount::new(2))
    .deals(Deals::new(3))
    .floor(Floor::cpm(1.50, Currency::USD))
    .build();

let json: String = req.to_json_string();
```

Same seed and config produce byte-identical output; the output is covered by a versioned
golden corpus. Knobs widen a profile, they never conflict with it, so `build()` cannot fail.

## API map

- `Request::builder(Profile)` — start here; `.seed()`, `.spec()`, `.impressions()`,
  `.deals()`, `.floor()`, `.build()`.
- `Request::write_json(&mut impl fmt::Write)` — no allocation, `no_std`.
- `Request::to_json_string()` — `String` (feature `alloc`, on by default).
- `SpecVersion` — `.spec(SpecVersion::V25)`; 2.6 is the default.
- `Currency`, `Floor`, `ImpressionCount`, `Deals` — typed knobs.
- `Profile::from_name(&str)` / `Profile::ALL` — profiles as data.
- `rtbgen::corpus::ALL` — versioned corpus of generated fixtures.
- `Request::from_entropy(profile, spec, &mut source)` — generate from any `Entropy` source;
  `Request::seed()` returns `None` for such a request.
- `RngEntropy`, `BytesEntropy`, `Share`, `Span` — the public entropy seam.

## Adapters

Optional features add APIs, never new bytes:

- `arbitrary` — `Request: arbitrary::Arbitrary`; every byte slice becomes one valid request.
- `proptest` — `rtbgen::proptest::request()` shrinks on the typed knobs, not raw bytes.
- `serde` — `Request: serde::Serialize`; `serde_json::to_string(&request)` equals
  `request.to_json_string()`.

## Profiles

`SiteDisplay`, `SiteVideo`, `SiteNative`, `AppRewarded`, `AppBanner`, `PmpDeals`,
`MultiImp`, `Sparse`, `Maximal`.

`Maximal` alternates `site` and `app` with the seed; OpenRTB forbids both at once.

## Command line

`rtbgen --profile app_rewarded --seed 42 --count 10000 --out ./requests/`,
`rtbgen --list-profiles`, `rtbgen corpus --verify`.
